name: timestamp-input-contract
objective:
PUBLIC BEHAVIOR: Unsupported input types passed to parse_timestamp must raise TypeError at the public parsing boundary, rather than leaking an AttributeError from string operations. Unsupported types include bool, numbers, bytes and arbitrary objects.
COMPATIBILITY: Preserve identity for Timestamp inputs; datetime/date support, UTC normalization, valid supported strings and None behavior remain unchanged. Empty and malformed strings must continue to raise TimestampParsingError, not TypeError. Keep public APIs and parsing formats.
QUALITY: Existing tests, independent supported/unsupported and exception-identity checks, strict typing, Ruff and formatting must all pass. No new public exception or unrelated refactor.
oracle:
from datetime import date, datetime, UTC, timedelta, timezone
from devtools.core.time import Timestamp, TimestampParsingError, parse_timestamp
for value in (True,False,1,1.5,b"2020-01-01",object(),[],{}):
    try: parse_timestamp(value)
    except TypeError: pass
    except Exception as error: raise AssertionError(type(error).__name__) from error
    else: raise AssertionError("unsupported type admitted")
for value in ("", "not-a-timestamp"):
    try: parse_timestamp(value)
    except TimestampParsingError: pass
    else: raise AssertionError("invalid string contract lost")
stamp=Timestamp(datetime(2020,1,1,tzinfo=UTC))
assert parse_timestamp(stamp) is stamp
assert parse_timestamp(date(2020,1,1))==stamp
assert parse_timestamp(datetime(2020,1,1))==stamp
assert parse_timestamp(datetime(2020,1,1,2,tzinfo=timezone(timedelta(hours=2))))==stamp
assert parse_timestamp("2020-01-01")==stamp
assert isinstance(parse_timestamp(None),Timestamp)
print("16 timestamp contract scenarios passed")
